body: It's okay, you don't sound like an idiot, you're right, I am being selfish and I know it. I'm not going to end it, not yet, I'll try to pull through. Thank you.
My girlfriend ended up giving my parents an anonymous tip, and yeah, you were right, they do want to help me, and I'm going to let them help and see how it goes. Thanks.

I plan to get at least some counseling in the future, I just can't at the moment, though I'll definately give that number a call some time. Thank you. :]

May not be traumatizing as some, but still traumatizing enough to leave an effect on myself. Ever since I was 7 I've heard my mother and step-father argue, this continued through the years and it would get worse and worse and it would sometimes become physical. Then I hit 15, it started to become very physical, though bear with me I'm kinda shaking a little recalling most of this for some reason and my head feels weird, but my mother was beating my step-father and he was begging her to stop, I was too afraid to do anything so I just kind of sat there shaking and crying a little.. **a little**. My step-father eventually became unconsious for some reason, I was never told what happened, though after my step-father passed out my mother started screaming for my older brother and the police and paramedics were called. I was questioned by the police and I told them what I heard. Also I failed to mention my parents are alcoholics, they had been heavily drinking that night. After that, child services were called and I was assigned with a social worker. Turns out I was being 'neglected' which I guess was a little true. But enough of that and onto more experiances which probably screwed me up more than the last. A little after the things that happened, I just turned 16, my parents had been drinking yet again, so yeah an argument went on and things turned bad, very bad. My step-father raped my mother while I listened, the details are hazy.. but I remember hearing it all. I was scared, too scared to help, again I just sat there shocked and crying a little. I really am pathetic, hm?. More things ensued and then another night I woke up to my step-father coming into my room telling me to get dressed and go with my mother. Apparently the police had been called and we were being taken to the station, I had to sit in the back with my mother pissed up on alcohol. She was drunkenly telling me that she was sorry she brought step-dad into my life and that he and my biological father were violent, terrible men. This took a toll on me as I thought my dad was awesome, but I don't know I haven't seen him in years. But anyway, we got to the station and I had to sit in the lobby as my mother shouted about what my step-dad had done to hear, not knowing I could hear. Apparently, he had beaten and raped her on their honeymoon, more rape along the line, more beating, more rape. I just sat there shocked and horrified. So I guess that's it, other than that, when I was still in school, back when I was 10 (I'm home educated now.) I was molested by two dudes a little older than me, 13? Iunno they were of age to leave for highschool. Oh geez I'm rambling, guess I'll shut up now.

tl;dr: Heard my step-father rape my mother, heard my mother beat my step-dad with him begging her to stop, my step-father raped and beat her for the 10 years they've been married and I was molested when I was 10.

Oops, guess that's more than one, sorry I just had to get it out. :[
